heading: Voting

chapter.title: OBLIGATIONS OF LISTED ENTITY WHICH HAS LISTED ITS INDIAN DEPOSITORY RECEIPTS

content:
79. (1) The listed entity shall, either directly or through an agent, send out proxy forms to
IDR Holders in all cases mentioning that a security holder may vote either for or against
each resolution.
(2) Voting rights of the IDR Holders shall be exercised in accordance with the depository
agreement.
